As part of our team, you'll be at the forefront of innovation, setting new industry standards and working on groundbreaking projects. Here, you'll not only advance your career but also make a significant impact on the future of technology. Job Summary Using a ticketing system, the Systems Administrator will determine priorities and contact end users to resolve issues. The Systems Administrator will troubleshoot, configure and/or replace laptop, desktop, and peripheral hardware components. Installs and configures MS Windows Operating Systems and other operating systems as specified. Supports and trains users in the effective use of technology. Keeping good documentation is critical and required. The Systems Administrator will ensure a high level of user satisfaction. The System Administrator must remain current with new and improved technology. Help IT Managed Service Provider to resolve network and server related issues. Will be required to back up Manager Operational Accounting on IT related issues and perform additional duties as requested by manager. Key Responsibilities Technical Troubleshoot software issues in a Windows environment. Troubleshoot hardware issues in related PCs, laptops, and peripherals. Knowledge and support for corporate infrastructure elements such as Active Directory, virtual servers, IIS, Office 365, Exchange, AX server, SharePoint, VMWare, Email Archivers, VOIP system, and backup and disaster recovery. Assists IT Managed Service Provider to set up, configure, and support internal and/or external networks and servers including hardware. Perform storage administration (Server, SAN and NAS). Maintain all systems, applications, security, and network configurations Assist with upgrades, patches, and new applications and equipment. Troubleshoot network performance issues and helps maintain IT capabilities to execute disaster recovery situation. Install and test necessary software and hardware. Provide 24 x 7 contact support for all AR entities. Assist in the purchasing of all IT equipment as required. IT Help Desk Act as the first line of technical support and response for end users. Ability to work in a high call volume environment. Resolve IT tickets related to tier 1 software and hardware support: Windows OS, Active Directory, Office D365, PCs, laptops, peripherals, etc. Assist in all levels of IT Help Desk. review_candidates.description: Job Location Remote, United States Tracking Code 1432-383 Position Type Full-Time/Regular Core4ce is seeking an Enterprise Network Services Engineer to design, implement, and maintain secure and scalable enterprise network infrastructures. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in network engineering, security, routing, firewall management, load balancing, and automation. This role requires deep knowledge of TCP/IP networking, encryption protocols, traffic analysis, scripting, and cloud networking. Additionally, the candidate will be responsible for planning IT security projects, troubleshooting complex network issues, and ensuring compliance with security policies. Responsibilities Design, configure, install, and manage enterprise network infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls, and load balancers. Plan and schedule the installation or modification of network hardware and software. Implement and maintain secure network configurations across multi-VRF Cisco routers and enterprise environments. Troubleshoot and analyze TCP/IP network traffic, including TCP 3-way handshake, TCP window scaling, and MSS. Capture and analyze network packets using TCPDump (Linux) and Flow Monitor Capture (Cisco ASR). Implement multi-protocol routing solutions with BGP, OSPF, and VRF-based networks. Use Wireshark, TCPDump, and other diagnostic tools for network performance analysis. Perform TLS/SSL handshake troubleshooting and security configuration. Network Security & Compliance Configure and maintain firewalls (Palo Alto, Cisco), including security policies, VPNs, and intrusion prevention systems (IPS). Implement AAA technologies (Cisco ISE, LDAP, OTP) for access management. Ensure certificate management and encryption, including TLS/SSL and OpenSSL operations. Install, configure, and troubleshoot digital certificates on F5 LTM/GTM/APM/ASM appliances. Implement F5 Client Constrained Delegation (C3D) for certificate delegation. Enable certificate-based authentication using Client-SSL profiles and APM policies. Performance Monitoring & Troubleshooting Deploy and maintain network monitoring, alerting, and repair systems in production environments. Troubleshoot BGP neighbor configurations, VPNv4 unicast summary, and OSPF network participation. Analyze DUP ACK packets, out-of-order segments, and retransmission issues. Optimize and troubleshoot load balancing solutions and DNS-based traffic management. Cloud & Virtualization Integration Manage and support cloud-based network services across Azure, AWS, and Oracle Cloud. Configure and maintain virtualized network appliances in VMware environments. Automation & Scripting Utilize Python and BASH scripting for network automation and troubleshooting. Develop scripts using REST APIs, Syslog, XML, and SNMP for automation. Use regular expressions (e.g., ".*", "^", "$") for scripting and log parsing. This position is designed to be flexible, with responsibilities evolving to meet business needs and enable individual growth. Requirements Minimum 4 years of hands-on experience as a Network Administrator or Network Security Engineer. Strong knowledge of OSI and TCP/IP network models, TCP 3-way handshake, and window scaling. Experience with Palo Alto and Cisco firewalls. Experience with F5 LTM, GTM, APM, ASM for load balancing and security. Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) certification or equivalent experience or willingness to get within 45 days of hire Ability to obtain a Secret Clearance (preference goes to candidates who possess an Active Secret Clearance) Preferred Qualifications Strong troubleshooting skills with routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, VRF, LISP). Familiarity with network packet capture tools (TCPDump, Wireshark). Understanding of essential network services (DNS, SMTP, NTP, IMAP, SNMP). Experience in TLS/SSL security, OpenSSL, and certificate management. Proficiency in scripting languages (Python, BASH) and automation tools. Experience working with Unix/Linux-based systems. Experience with network automation (REST APIs, Syslog, XML, SNMP). Experience deploying and troubleshooting load-balanced services and SSL certificate management. Familiarity with multi-cloud networking (Azure, AWS, Oracle Cloud). Experience working with Puppet Labs or SaltStack configuration management Why Work for Us? Core4ce is a team of innovators, self-starters, and critical thinkers—driven by a shared mission to strengthen national security and advance warfighting outcomes. We Offer 401(k) with 100% company match on the first 6% deferred, with immediate vesting Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage—employee portion paid 100% by Core4ce Unlimited access to training and certifications, with no pre-set cap on eligible professional development Tuition assistance for job-related degrees and courses Paid parental leave, PTO that grows with tenure, and generous holiday schedules Got a big idea? Working knowledge of Microsoft Hyper-V, VMware , or other enterprise virtualization platforms. Experience with enterprise automation, monitoring, and reporting. Enable link failover, load balancing, and centralized SD-WAN management, including for higher-availability requirements. Lead customers through integrating their network with public IaaS/SaaS providers, adapting the approach for less common environments. ZTNA Deploy ZTNA solutions to provide secure, identity- and application-based remote access, including for more complex user and application landscapes. SASE Configure SASE architectures integrating SD-WAN with cloud-delivered security services for multi-site or moderately complex environments. Hands-on experience connecting SD-WAN/SASE fabrics to cloud environments via IPsec VPN, and familiarity with direct-connect style private connectivity options (AWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute, or equivalent). Working knowledge of cloud security fundamentals — security groups/NSGs, cloud-native firewalls, and basic IAM concepts — sufficient to align on-prem security policy with cloud-side controls. Familiarity with securing hybrid and multi-cloud connectivity patterns, including SaaS access and cloud workload protection at a foundational level. Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the judgment to know when to act independently and when to loop in others. Ability to work independently on complex engagements while remaining an effective collaborator across pre-sales, delivery, and support teams. Customer-focused mindset with strong attention to detail, balanced with the ability to move quickly under deadline pressure. Collaborative, growth-oriented work environment with mentoring opportunities in both directions. Training and certification opportunities.
